List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  the March 3, 2008/Phalguna 13, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Food Processing Industries; Human Resource Development; Law
and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and Renewable Energy; Power;
Social Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Women and Child
Development)
Total number of questions — 20
20
Setting up of Disability
Rehabilitation Centres
in Madhya Pradesh
†*61. SHRIMATI MAY A SINGH: Will
the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
proposal for setting up of Disability
Rehabilitation Centres for the disabled
persons in every district;
(b) whether these Centres have been
set-up in only 17 districts of Madhya
Pradesh till date and if so, by when the
permission for setting up these Centres in
the remaining districts would be given; and
(c) by when the financial assistance/
grant would be sanctioned for setting up
sufficient number of these Centres keeping
in view that there are 14 lakh disabled
persons in the State and the present
arrangement is inadequate for them?
Power crisis
*62. DR. ABHISHEK MANU
SINGHVI: Will the Minister of POWER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
many States in the country are facing a
major power crisis which, in turn, is
hampering their development in a major
way;
(b) if so, what efforts are being made in
co-ordination with the affected State
Governments to rectify the situation;
(c) whether a time frame has been set to
address the problem; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Tribal rights to forest land
*63. SHRI O. T. LEPCHA:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the rules and regulations
pertaining to tribal rights to forest land have
since been framed and notified and the
relevant Act of Parliament brought into
force;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
details of new policy guidelines issued in
this regard; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

21
(c) since when the same have been
enforced?
Setting up of Supreme Court and
High Court Bench in Andhra
Pradesh
*64. SHRIMATI N. P. DURGA : Will
the Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Andhra
Pradesh Legislative Council has requested
for setting up of a Bench of Supreme Court
in Hyderabad;
(b) whether it has also requested for
setting up a Bench of High Court in coastal
Rayalaseema region of the State; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the action
contemplated by Government on these
requests?
Swadhar Shelter Homes Scheme
*65. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of WOMEN
AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the objective and genesis of Swadhar
Shelter Homes Scheme;
(b) the progress/achievements thereof
till date, particularly in Rajasthan; and
(c) the number of widows, divorced,
separated women, both in rural and urban
areas, rehabilitated, out of 342.90 lakh
widowed women and 23.43 lakh divorced
or separated women in the country, as per
2001 census?
Reservation benefits to dalit
christians and muslims
*66. PROF. P. J. KURIEN: Will the
Minister of MINORITY AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether dalit christians and muslims
have asked for reservation benefits;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the reaction of Government to their
demand?
Social security policy for minorities
*67. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
Minister of MINORITY AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is actively
considering to introduce a social security
policy for the families of minorities,
particularly muslims, living below poverty
line and the lower middle class, and also for
those who are mentally retarded and
physically disabled;
(b) if so, the details thereof and by when
it is expected to be introduced;
(c) how far the minorities are expected
to be benefited; and
(d) the States where it would be
introduced first and by when in Uttar
Pradesh?
Establishment of IIM in Andhra
Pradesh
*68. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Andhra Pradesh
Government has proposed to his Ministry
to establish Indian Institute of Management
at Visakhapatnam in Andhra Pradesh, in
view of the fact that this city has a major
port and houses numerous big private and
public sector companies;
(b) if so, the details and status of the
proposal;
(c) the reasons for delay in sanctioning
it; and

22
(d) by when it is likely to be given
clearance?
